ActionData.description:
What one seat did in one phase, after clamping and abstention rules.

``value`` is the effective number (exit price, grab price or bid). ``raw_value`` is only
set when the effective value was clamped to the remaining budget.
ActionData.title: ActionData

ActionEvent.description: The decision of one seat in one phase, with its inner monologue.
ActionEvent.title: ActionEvent

AwardData.description:
One award. A vacant award has no winners. Ties list every winner.

``basis`` says whether the award rests on public facts or on private values, which a viewer
shows only with the god view.
AwardData.title: AwardData

AwardEvent.description: An award or a vacant award. Audience only.
AwardEvent.title: AwardEvent

CostEventData.description: Cost bookkeeping. ``cap_reached`` is the moment the cost gate fired.
CostEventData.title: CostEventData

DealPrivateData.description: Private cards of one seat: budget, valuations, blind-box signals and mission.
DealPrivateData.title: DealPrivateData

DutchResultData.description:
Outcome of the descending clock.

``ladder`` holds the prices of the levels in play, highest first (levels below the
reserve are skipped). ``level`` is the 1-based position of the level that fired.
DutchResultData.title: DutchResultData

DutchResultEvent.description: Outcome of the descending clock. Public.
DutchResultEvent.title: DutchResultEvent

EnglishDropoutData.description: A seat leaves the ascending clock. Non-participants are announced at price 0.
EnglishDropoutData.title: EnglishDropoutData

EnglishDropoutEvent.description: A seat leaves the ascending clock. Public.
EnglishDropoutEvent.title: EnglishDropoutEvent

Extraction.description:
A promise or a claim about the speaker's own hand, quoted by a judge.

``promise_class`` says what a promise is about (``collusion`` for an agreement to keep a
price down or to take turns) and ``partner`` the seat that such a promise names.
Extraction.title: Extraction

GuessData.description:
A mind-reading guess of another seat's remaining budget.

The truth is deliberately not stored: an event the guesser may see must not reveal the
target's budget. The replay export adds the truth afterwards.
GuessData.title: GuessData

GuessEvent.description: A mind-reading guess, visible to its author only until the night ends.
GuessEvent.title: GuessEvent

HammerData.description: The lot is decided. Sealed formats also reveal every effective bid (0 if none).
HammerData.title: HammerData

HostLineData.description: Offline commentary written after the night from the fact cards.
HostLineData.title: HostLineData

InjectionFlag.description: Speech that tried to impersonate the system or change the rules.
InjectionFlag.title: InjectionFlag

JudgeExtractData.description: Raw extraction of one judge. Seat numbers come from events, never from the text.
JudgeExtractData.title: JudgeExtractData

JudgeExtractEvent.description: Raw output of one judge. Audience only.
JudgeExtractEvent.title: JudgeExtractEvent

JudgeVerdictData.description:
A finding that survived the rules: program-decided or confirmed by both judges.

For a false claim, ``topic`` is what the claim was about and ``gap_milli`` how far it was
from the truth, in thousandths of the tier for a value and of the budget for a budget. For a
collusion finding, ``statistic_milli`` holds the bid statistic of each screened lot in
thousandths of the tier and ``threshold_milli`` the threshold it was compared with.
JudgeVerdictData.title: JudgeVerdictData

LotOpenData.description: A lot opens. ``active`` seats will be asked to act, ``sitting_out`` seats will not.
LotOpenData.title: LotOpenData

LotPlan.description: Public pre-show entry for one lot. The blind-box value is not part of it.
LotPlan.title: LotPlan

MissionGuess.description: A judge's guess of one seat's secret mission, from public behaviour only.
MissionGuess.title: MissionGuess

MissionResultData.description: Mission outcome, published after the last lot.
MissionResultData.title: MissionResultData

MissionResultEvent.description: Mission outcome after the last lot. Public.
MissionResultEvent.title: MissionResultEvent

NightEndData.description: Final scores of every seat. Bots have no ``rank_tonight``.
NightEndData.title: NightEndData

NightEndEvent.description: Closes the night with the final scores. Public.
NightEndEvent.title: NightEndEvent

NightStartData.description: Public pre-show: the whole lot sequence and the seat list.
NightStartData.title: NightStartData

ParseRepairData.description:
Repairs applied while turning a model reply into an action (one attempt).

``status`` says how the attempt ended: ``ok`` (an action was read), ``retry`` (another
attempt follows) or ``abstain`` (the seat abstains).
ParseRepairData.title: ParseRepairData

ParseRepairEvent.description: Repairs on one attempt. System only.
ParseRepairEvent.title: ParseRepairEvent

PlanData.description: The opening plan of one seat (sanitised).
PlanData.title: PlanData

Pledge.description: A structured, public pledge. Breaking it is decided by program, not by a judge.
Pledge.title: Pledge

SeatPublic.description: What every seat may know about a seat: its code name and whether it is a bot.
SeatPublic.title: SeatPublic

SeatScore.description: Final tally of one seat. Surplus and mission bonus are kept apart.
SeatScore.title: SeatScore

SeedCommitData.description: Commitment to the deal seed before the night, and its reveal after.
SeedCommitData.title: SeedCommitData

SeedCommitEvent.description: Seed commitment before the night and reveal after it. Public.
SeedCommitEvent.title: SeedCommitEvent

ShillMission.description: Push lot ``lot`` to at least ``threshold_price`` without buying it.
ShillMission.title: ShillMission

TalkData.description: One line in the public channel, already sanitised, with an optional pledge.
TalkData.title: TalkData

TalkEvent.description: A line in the public channel.
TalkEvent.title: TalkEvent
